run_im_detect_bbox: run RetinaNet detection on a single image using a trained model and return class-wise bounding boxes
create_cell_anchors: create cell anchors for all FPN levels, scales, and aspect ratios for RetinaNet inference
test_im_detect_bbox: test the im_detect_bbox function by running RetinaNet detection on an image with a Caffe2 model
review_im_detect_bbox: review the im_detect_bbox function to understand how it generates detections across FPN levels and applies NMS
refactor_create_cell_anchors: refactor the _create_cell_anchors function to support custom anchor scales and aspect ratios from configuration
